official_evaluator.metrics: advisory and entry recall only; false positives are not penalized

aegis_supplemental_evaluator_self_check.interpretation: Parser/matcher self-check only; not an Aegis or model score.

finding: The released data schema permits line ranges, but the pinned official evaluator converts ground-truth endpoint lines with int(...); all 44 entries containing a range string are consequently unmatched even when the prediction copies the annotated paths and lines exactly.
interpretation: Evaluator/schema compatibility defect. These oracle results are not an Aegis score, model score, or meaningful performance ceiling. Do not compare a future Aegis result to these figures.
